definitions.explanation: A genre of sentimental Japanese popular music characterized by distinctive vocal techniques and emotional themes of love, loss, and nostalgia.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{演歌|えんか}が{好|す}きだ。
カラオケで{演歌|えんか}を{歌|うた}った。
{演歌|えんか}{歌手|かしゅ}の{公演|こうえん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to an enka singer's concert.

examples.japanese: {演歌|えんか}は{日本|にほん}の{伝統的|でんとうてき}な{歌謡曲|かようきょく}のジャンルだ。
examples.english: Enka is a genre of traditional Japanese popular music.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}の{紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}では、{毎年|まいとし}{演歌|えんか}が{何曲|なんきょく}も{歌|うた}われる。
examples.english: At the year-end Kohaku singing contest, several enka songs are performed every year.

notes:
MUSICAL CHARACTERISTICS:
- {小節|こぶし} (melismatic vocal technique)
- {情感|じょうかん}のこもった{歌|うた}い{方|かた} (emotionally expressive singing)
- {哀愁|あいしゅう}のあるメロディー (melancholic melodies)

COMMON THEMES:
- {愛|あい} (love)
- {別|わか}れ (parting)
- {故郷|ふるさと} (hometown)
- {酒|さけ} (alcohol/drinking)
- {人生|じんせい} (life)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演歌|えんか}を{歌|うた}う (to sing enka)
- {演歌|えんか}{歌手|かしゅ} (enka singer)
- {演歌|えんか}{番組|ばんぐみ} (enka TV program)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{演歌|えんか} is particularly popular among older generations in Japan. Famous singers include {北島|きたじま}{三郎|さぶろう}, {美空|みそら}ひばり, and {氷川|ひかわ}きよし.
